steps.name: Refine and plan
steps.instructions: Read project rules, task and direct blockers, approved Brief snapshot and published project OKF v0.2 concepts, including specifications prepared outside KOS; code/tests show actual behavior. Treat project concepts as the maintained required behavior and Brief artifacts as a dated, self-contained snapshot, not another full normative copy. Compare their revisions and boundaries; if they differ materially or a requirement is missing, relay the question to the orchestrator rather than silently choosing. Refine task outcome, criteria, dependencies and normal, alternative, error, edge and security cases. Number task questions Q-01 onward across steps with answers or open status, owner and resolution point. Relay necessary human questions one at a time with context, a reasoned recommendation in parentheses and plain language; a wizard may show several only sequentially. Do not invent factual answers or adopt an unapproved proposal as a requirement. Resolve permitted technical choices independently. For changed required behavior explicitly load kos-project-docs, get separate human agreement and update the affected domain concept before implementation. Save a task-specific minimal plan with AC-to-check mapping and risks; do not repeat the full Brief scenarios.

templates.implementation_plan:
# Task implementation plan

## Approved sources and scope
<Task, Brief IDs and snapshot, published project path/revision and discrepancies or open decisions.>

## Approach and criteria
<Minimal design, relevant AC IDs, normal/error/edge cases, dependencies and risks.>

## Checks and questions
<Map criteria to meaningful checks; consecutive task Q IDs with answers or open status, owner and resolution point.>

steps.name: Implement and test
steps.instructions: Implement approved work in the verified worktree following project rules and normative concepts. Write meaningful tests for changed behavior and error/edge cases; for documentation-only changes use applicable document checks. Run relevant project checks and save actual commands, outcomes and AC coverage in test_report. Fix failures and rerun affected checks; do not silently change required behavior to fit code.

templates.test_report:
# Implementation and checks

## Change
<Actual change and revision or diff.>

## Checks and coverage
<Commands, observed results and AC coverage, including failures and not-run checks.>

## Corrections and blockers
<Fixes, reruns and unresolved obstacles.>

steps.name: Review and resolve findings
steps.instructions: As an independent reviewer, inspect the complete diff, checks, task criteria, Brief snapshot, approved project concepts, project rules, architecture and security. Record each concrete finding's location, evidence, impact, correction and high/medium/low severity, or explicitly state no findings. High and medium findings must be corrected by the implementation executor and independently re-reviewed with affected checks rerun on this step; low findings may remain with rationale. Escalate changes to approved behavior for human agreement; do not approve solely because reports exist.

templates.review_report:
# Independent review

## Scope and verdict
<Reviewer, full diff, criteria and actual check evidence.>

## Findings
<Concrete location, evidence, impact, severity and correction for each; explicitly state none if applicable.>

## Corrections and renewed review
<Fixes, rerun evidence, new verdict and rationale for deferred low findings.>

## Coverage
<AC coverage and unresolved risks.>

steps.name: Update project documentation
steps.instructions: Explicitly load kos-project-docs and inspect affected domain concepts in the project's OKF v0.2 bundle. Only change required behavior after separate human approval; code and tests describe actual behavior. For unchanged norm record inspected concepts and why no edit was needed. Save documentation_report with concrete review findings about project documentation, locations, effects and verified corrections, or explicitly say no findings. Review links, frontmatter, navigation and full document diff; rerun affected checks. If late changes affect reviewed behavior, obtain renewed independent review before publication.

templates.documentation_report:
# Normative documentation check

## Domains and decisions
<Affected concepts and explicit human agreement for changed requirements, or why norm is unchanged.>

## Review findings and corrections
<Each concrete documentation finding, location, effect and verified fix, or explicitly state no findings.>

## Checks and review impact
<Actual link/frontmatter/diff checks, reruns and whether renewed independent review is needed or obtained.>

steps.name: Publish and verify
steps.instructions: Publication is part of the assigned task. Inspect status, full diff, tests, review, documentation and project rules. Resolve high and medium findings; rerun affected checks and renew independent review when later edits change reviewed behavior. Publish by the project route and independently verify destination and revision; if ambiguous inspect before retrying, retain the worktree and stay on this step. Record specific remaining documentation/review findings or explicit absence, verified corrections and final check evidence in publication_report. Only the orchestrator may complete after verification and report result and next task in plain language.

templates.publication_report:
# Execution publication

## Published result
<Destination, independently verified revision/link and observed outcome.>

## Final checks and findings
<Final diff, actual test and document check evidence; concrete remaining findings or explicitly none, verified corrections and renewed review if needed.>

## Recovery or completion
<Uncertainty and destination inspection, or confirmed publication for orchestrator.>
